prs.title: feat(tally): hide rare words with --min-count
prs.head: feat/min-count
prs.author: dev
prs.body:
## Why
Long files print a tail of words seen once.

## What changed
- `--min-count N` hides words seen fewer than N times.

## Scope
- Single-word counts only.

## Blast Radius
The default of 1 keeps output byte-identical.

## Verification
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`

prs.title: feat(tally): count adjacent word pairs with --pairs
prs.head: feat/pairs-stack
prs.author: dev
prs.body:
## Why
Some reports want the most common two-word phrases.

## What changed
- `--pairs` counts adjacent pairs, lowercased like single words.

## Scope
- Pairs stay within one line.

## Blast Radius
Only runs that pass `--pairs` change.

## Verification
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`
